conversation.user: I'm considering the Construction Management Bachelor of Technology. Give me a brief introduction.
conversation.advisor:
The **Construction Management Bachelor of Technology** is a degree-completion program focused on developing **management, technical, and interpersonal skills for construction projects**.

- **School:** School of Construction and the Environment  
- **Location:** Burnaby  
- **Delivery:** In person  
- **Study options:** Full-time or part-time  
- **Curriculum areas:** Construction controls and techniques, organization management, stakeholder engagement, management electives, liberal studies, and professional standards.

Program details: [Construction Management Bachelor of Technology](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/)
